# Project-local YOLO Python packages

`setup_yolo.ps1` installs pinned Ultralytics runtime packages under `third_party/python`. This directory is ignored by source control and does not change the system Python or Isaac Sim installation.

Pinned versions are listed in `requirements-yolo.txt`. Package license metadata is retained inside each installed distribution. Review those licenses and the official Ultralytics licensing terms before any use beyond this local simulation.
